source: PayScale South Africa job salary research pages

careers.name: Account Manager
careers.description: Account managers are responsible for managing relationships with specific customers for their organization, including completing sales. These managers must have a thorough knowledge of their organization's products and services and need to be able to make targeted pitches for current and future clients.

careers.name: Regional Sales Manager
careers.description: Regional sales managers work in both retail and non-retail settings to oversee other sales managers within their district. They may develop marketing programs to increase sales of existing products or services, as well as introduce new products and lead regular sales meetings.

careers.name: Key Account Manager
careers.description: Key account managers are generally responsible for ensuring that a company's products and services are provided in an acceptable manner to accounts with its most important customers. These managers are often in charge of only one or a few accounts depending on their sizes, and this is often a sales position.

careers.name: Inside Sales Representative
careers.description: An inside sales representative works for a company that wants to sell a product or service. It is the inside sales representative's job to complete the process of that sale from start to finish.

careers.name: Sales Representative
careers.description: Sales representatives sell products and services for a company, either directly to consumers or to other businesses. These representatives often have goals which must be reached, and commission may be offered based on sales performance.

careers.name: Marketing Assistant
careers.description: A marketing assistant is an employee who works within a company's marketing department. He or she typically works to help with data collection and analysis for market research.

careers.name: National Sales Manager
careers.description: National sales managers must have worked as successful salespersons. In addition to being good salespersons, they must have leadership and managerial skills.

careers.name: Sales Assistant
careers.description: A sales assistant usually works in a retail store. The merchandise sold can vary greatly, from clothing to automotive parts to electronics.

careers.name: Sales and Service Consultant
careers.description: Sales and service consultants are responsible for increasing sales and providing superior customer service to clients for their organization. They provide product information, close sales, build brand loyalty, and respond to client inquiries and complaints.

careers.name: Outside Sales Representative
careers.description: Outside sales representatives have a variety of job duties depending on their company or organization. In most cases, this career largely consists of making sales calls not only to potential clients, but to existing ones as well.

careers.name: Salesperson / Salesman / Saleswoman
careers.description: Salespeople are employed to sell products to customers. While the details of their work depend heavily on the size of the employer, its industry, and its management style, in all cases the main objective is to maximize products sold and achieve high customer satisfaction.

careers.name: Account Executive
careers.description: An account executive usually holds a sales position, typically selling services and products to other businesses and individuals. Generally, the executive's company sets sales quotas that must be met to succeed in this position.

careers.name: Sales Director
careers.description: Sales directors are high-level management employees and occasional executives who are responsible for directing sales teams, either for an entire company or within a regional or branding division. The sales director provides vision and guidance to the team and entrusts it to execute projected revenue quotas.

careers.name: Travel Consultant
careers.description: Travel consultants assess the client's needs and expectations for a travel experience, and then provide them with the best travel options. They work to build an ongoing relationship with the customer to open the door for future bookings through the company.

careers.name: Customer Sales Representative (CSR)
careers.description: Customer sales representatives (CSRs) help build the business by bringing in new sales accounts and clients, as well as serve as a liaison between the customer and the company. Much of the role involves sales work and expert product knowledge.

careers.name: Sales Manager
careers.description: Sales managers may work in both retail and non-retail settings. Sales managers are responsible for the day-to-day management of sales activities and sales associates.

careers.name: Sales Representative, Pharmaceuticals
careers.description: Sales representatives in the pharmaceutical industry call on existing and potential clients to establish new accounts, obtain orders, service existing accounts, and implement brand strategies intended to convey the company's marketing message.

careers.name: Sales Engineer
careers.description: Sales engineers are primarily concerned with overall company revenue and increasing profits. Most of the time, sales engineers work directly with customers either in an office or at a client's site.

careers.name: Insurance Broker
careers.description: Insurance brokers often work as agents of large insurance companies or independently; in either case, they work directly with clients and must have necessary licenses. They provide insurance quotes via phone, online, or in-person after assessing consumers' individual needs.

careers.name: Area Sales Manager
careers.description: An area sales manager handles a number of departmental or organizational responsibilities. They orchestrate a sales team, set short-term and long-term goals for a sales division, collaborate with other departments, and conduct meetings.

careers.name: General Sales Manager
careers.description: General sales managers oversee the sales department at a company or business. Their duties often include hiring and training sales employees, working with the sales team to ensure they meet goals and targets, and ensuring that the company is bringing in enough revenue.

careers.name: Senior Account Manager
careers.description: A senior account manager supports a sales team in hopes of driving up revenue and growing the client base. They provide leadership for the sales team, build strong business relationships, and establish lines of communication with staff, clients, and partners.

careers.name: Sales and Marketing Manager
careers.description: Sales and marketing managers may play a dual role, as sales and marketing are usually two different departments or functions. Marketing develops ideas to reach people and sell products; sales implements those ideas to sell the product.

careers.name: Business Development Executive
careers.description: Business development executives attract new consumers through effective marketing, find brands and companies for joint ventures, research market trends, and build the brand's reputation with consumers.

careers.name: Account Manager Sales
careers.description: An account manager for sales is responsible for creating and maintaining relationships with various customers, who may be individuals or businesses. These managers generally have a certain number of accounts to oversee and continue to offer products to, and they must follow up with customers to make sure that they are satisfied.

careers.name: Senior Sales Executive
careers.description: A senior sales executive typically has a strong sales management background, a proven track record of success in sales, and skills with executive leadership. It is vital that a senior sales executive is able to identify new markets or client prospects and also strengthen relationships with existing clients.

careers.name: Sales Person
careers.description: Sales people work with customers and clientele, persuading them to purchase products or services and helping place orders. There are many different types of sales people.

careers.name: Sales Assistant, Inside
careers.description: The inside sales assistant helps sales managers and representatives fulfill the primary functions of their jobs. The sales assistant aids in finding potential clients, screening new clients, and presenting information to clients; they often act as a point of contact for clients and provide post-deal support.

careers.name: Insurance Sales Agent
careers.description: An insurance sales agent is a person who helps individuals choose a policy that most closely fits their needs. The sales agent will typically represent and work for an individual company, but independent agents who represent many smaller insurance entities exist as well.

careers.name: Sales Specialist
careers.description: Sales specialists' main duty is to explain the specifications and features of a product or service to existing or potential customers, with the goal of making a sale. Sometimes, sales specialists also forecast a company's potential sales and ensure these targets are met.

careers.name: Business Banker
careers.description: Business bankers work in a financial institution and manage a business loan portfolio that may include small and/or large organizations. They perform careful analysis of prospective clients' needs and best options, working with the client to determine optimal banking solutions.

careers.name: Internal Sales Engineer
careers.description: An internal sales engineer is a salesperson who is an employee of a company (as opposed to a contract salesperson), and he or she is typically tasked with selling advanced mechanical or electrical equipment. They are usually given certain accounts and are tasked with enhancing existing sales relationships.

careers.name: Real Estate Agent
careers.description: Real estate agents work with clients in order to facilitate the sale and purchase of property and houses. Real estate agents review property value and similar sale prices in an area to determine reasonable prices for selling and buying property.

careers.name: Relationship Banker
careers.description: A relationship banker is an employee of a bank or other lending institution that is responsible for dealing with customers on a one-on-one basis. This may mean being assigned specific clients or patrons and subsequently handling all transactions and assistance for them, or it may simply mean that the banker works in the front of the bank, dealing with most personal interactions that require expert help that tellers cannot provide.

careers.name: Technical Sales Representative (TSR)
careers.description: A technical sales representative works as a liaison between a company's regional sales manager/acquisition manager and clients. The technical sales representative assists the regional sales manager in generating market development plans, which means the representative must be familiar with the products the company currently offers and the client's opinions of those products.

careers.name: Branch Sales Manager
careers.description: Branch sales managers oversee a certain branch, or location, of a company. They are in charge of the everyday business within their branch, and they work to manage client relationships by providing excellent customer service.

careers.name: Key National Account Manager
careers.description: A key national account manager is responsible for developing excellent partnerships with current and future clients. They must meet organizational sales goals and ensure they meet all clients' needs.

careers.name: Sales Representative, Pharmaceutical Equipment
careers.description: Sales representatives for pharmaceutical equipment sell medical equipment to pharmacies, pharmaceutical factories, and medical personnel, such as doctors and nurses. Usually, there is commission in this job based on sales made, and strong communication and customer service skills are important in order to generate sales.

careers.name: Travel Agent
careers.description: A travel agent assists individuals or groups of persons in planning and booking travel. This can include facilitating ticket purchases for transportation, reserving accommodations, and renting cars.

careers.name: Marketing Intern
careers.description: Most marketing interns are nearing graduation from their college careers and have an interest in the field, and a marketing internship can be a stepping stone from college life to a marketing career. Some marketing internships are paid, while others are unpaid depending on the position or organization and its budget.

careers.name: Medical Device Sales Representative
careers.description: Medical device sales representatives are responsible for selling medical devices to both companies and private practice clinics. The representative is tasked with locating potential customers and giving a persuasive demonstration of the devices to those which show interest.

careers.name: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
careers.description: Sales development representatives (SDRs) make outbound sales by reaching out to clients to obtain leads and schedule appointments for the sales team. It's important that they are highly familiar with the products being sold to answer any questions, and there may be periodic goals to be met in this position and commission based on sales made.

careers.name: Channel Sales Manager
careers.description: Channel sales managers are responsible for developing and completing sales with outside dealers. They lead a team of sales personnel, motivating and training them to produce the best possible results.

careers.name: Sales Account Executive
careers.description: Sales account executives are responsible for maintaining and managing customer accounts. Their main goal is to solicit and acquire new business for a company.

careers.name: Sales Advisor
careers.description: Sales advisors work in a number of job settings from retail outlets to banks to call centers. These individuals, who must have excellent product knowledge, generally supervise all aspects of the company’s sales process.

careers.name: Sales Team Leader, Services
careers.description: A services sales team leader generally leads a team of salespeople to accomplish sales goals related to their organization's services. They establish sales goals that their team needs to achieve; when targets are not achieved, they must develop solutions to overcome the issues hindering sales.

careers.name: Field Sales Executive
careers.description: Field sales executives are the head of the sales department that leaves a business to make its sales. Field sales executives function much the same as other sales executives, except that they must work with a different approach, as their employees actually go out into public to make their sales.

careers.name: Insurance Sales Representative
careers.description: The insurance sales representative takes on the responsibility of communicating with new and existing clients for the purpose of selling insurance policies, advising clients, and gathering information. These representatives are tasked not only with selling a policy to clients, but also with developing strong working relationships by getting to know clients' needs, resources, and property or persons to be insured.

careers.name: Senior Account Executive
careers.description: Senior account executives are typically responsible for sales and marketing projects. They are expected to achieve sales targets by acquiring new clients or accounts, as well as identify opportunities for marketing to prospective clients.

careers.name: Business Development Representative
careers.description: A business development representative is a specialized role related to the sales department of a company. While a sales representative works with existing clients to keep them happy and serve their needs, business development reps seek out and build new business for their enterprise.

careers.name: Investment Consultant
careers.description: The investment consultant holds an advisory position and works with their company's clients or as a contractor for multiple organizations. Brokerage firms and investment advisory companies are typical employers for investment consultants.

careers.name: Sales Support Specialist
careers.description: Sales support specialists are responsible for providing support during the sales process. They help customers resolve sales-related issues in a timely manner, generally providing real-time support.

careers.name: Territory Sales Representative
careers.description: A territory sales representative performs general oversight of company's operations in a particular region, for example, specific states, specific provinces, or larger-level regions. These individuals typically manage a number of stores or sales operations for their region, ensuring that operations run smoothly and target goals and revenues are met.

careers.name: F&I Manager
careers.description: F&I managers, also known as "finance and insurance managers," sell both new and used cars to customers who intend to purchase finance and insurance options. They work to provide buyers with the most suitable options for their vehicle purchases which fit within their budgets and do not negatively affect their loans.

careers.name: Sales Support Representative
careers.description: Sales support representative serve as a liaison between a company and its customers. They perform a number of responsibilities related to engaging new and existing clients, with the goal of generating sales and retaining customers.

careers.name: Technical Sales Manager
careers.description: Technical sales managers are responsible for a variety of tasks related to technical sales, including analyzing competitors, developing sales opportunities, and closing new accounts over phone, fax, and email.

careers.name: National Account Manager
careers.description: National account managers are responsible for managing relationships with ongoing clients, especially those who are considered of high importance and make a large amount of purchases. National account managers should also research new clients in order to establish new accounts.

careers.name: Operations Support Specialist
careers.description: The operations support specialist position requires different skills depending on the company and position. Potential responsibilities include accounting, scheduling, and other bookkeeping; several universal responsibilities are the ability to type quickly and accurately, a basic knowledge of computers and software relevant to the position, and the ability to adapt to new software quickly.

careers.name: Sales Representative, Industrial Product
careers.description: Industrial products sales representatives are primarily responsible for selling industrial products to either specific types of individuals (such as members of a particular profession) or companies within a defined geographic region. These sales representatives work in a variety of fields, including industrial manufacturing, industrial supply production, and industrial distribution.

careers.name: Trader, Commodities
careers.description: Commodities traders facilitate transactions related to commodities such as securities, stocks and bonds, currency, agricultural output, and others. These traders work with clients to evaluate the market, analyze its movements and tendencies, and use this information to develop sound financial advice for clients.

careers.name: Channel Account Manager
careers.description: Channel account managers are responsible for maintaining strong relationships with clients for various businesses. Generally, these account managers must arrange situations which allow for colleagues within their businesses to meet and converse for the greater good of the company; be it selling a product or brainstorming ways to increase revenue, the channel account manager is responsible for overseeing this creation.

careers.name: Leasing Agent, Real Estate
careers.description: One of the most common ways for people to put a roof over their heads is to lease a property, such as an apartment or rental home. Many businesses, especially small businesses, lease business space, rather than deal with the extra expense and hassle of property ownership.

careers.name: Sales Consultant, Medical Sales
careers.description: Sales consultants for medical sales serve as intermediaries between pharmaceutical/biotech companies and practicing physicians/hospitals, and their job is to execute marking strategies and bring medicines and drugs to those who dispense them. They often travel from place to place to inform physicians and managers who may not know of their products or their benefits.

careers.name: Sales & Marketing Assistant
careers.description: A sales and marketing assistants generally help with a company's marketing and sales initiatives by following through with promotions and marketing campaigns. This can include updating social media, creating promotional email campaigns, coordinating exhibit and trade show appearances, and contacting customers.

careers.name: International Sales Manager
careers.description: An international sales manager works for a business that export goods and services to other countries. They ensure that operations overseas flow smoothly on a day-to-day basis, including the delivery of goods to their purchaser.

careers.name: Junior Account Executive
careers.description: A junior account executive usually works in the marketing and sales field under an account executive to carry out delegated tasks. Duties that a junior account executive may handle include developing marketing campaigns and sales initiatives, as well as overseeing a variety of accounts.

careers.name: Director of Sales
careers.description: Directors of sales typically lead and manage a team of sales representatives and set expectations and goals for the team to meet and a general vision to follow. The director's success often depends on the sales team's performance, so they are indeed responsible for motivating the team to achieve goals and exceed expectations.

careers.name: Insurance Agent
careers.description: An insurance agent typically sells one or more type of policy from an office environment such as an agency, brokerage firm, or insurance company. Insurance agents who work for a brokerage firm will likely sell policies from multiple companies.

careers.name: Sales Administration Manager
careers.description: Sales administration managers are responsible for administrating sales-related aspects and managing all sales-specific administrative tasks on behalf of their organization. They facilitate and process all sales-related tasks, complete and approve administrative paperwork, keep accurate sales records for future reference, and maintain a sales database.

careers.name: Technical Sales Engineer
careers.description: A technical sales engineer possesses a blend of sales ability and technical knowledge that enables them to determine client needs, spec out complex technical systems, and ensure that pricing meets the needs of both their employer’s expected profit margins and their client’s budget.

careers.name: Commercial Sales Manager
careers.description: Commercial sales managers are responsible for performing and managing all commercial sales aspects on behalf of their organization. These individuals have strong analytical skills that they utilize to sell products or services and complete sales-related activities.

careers.name: Area Sales Regional Manager
careers.description: Area sales regional managers (also called area sales managers or regional sales managers) are generally considered part of the sales and marketing branch of an organization. Area sales regional managers may work in a variety of industries including manufacturing, construction, electronics, and retail, among others.

careers.name: Regional Sales Director
careers.description: A regional sales director holds a high-level management position and is charged with overseeing revenue generation strategies for multiple locations, stores, and retail outlets. Companies that hire a regional sales director typically rely on consumer sales through these retail outlets as the primary means of creating profits.

careers.name: Junior Account Manager
careers.description: A junior account manager is a valued member of a sales force at a company. This team member typically works under the guidance of a senior account manager or senior sales manager.

careers.name: Territory Sales Manager
careers.description: A territory sales manager oversees a specific area (or territory) for an organization and acts as a liaison between company headquarters and the company’s presence in their respective territory. Often, the territory sales manager’s primary job is to increase sales volume within their assigned region.

careers.name: Account Manager, Advertising
careers.description: Advertising account manager are responsible for effectively managing all advertising accounts for their company. They participate in all aspects of advertising, from idea creation to development to advertising distribution.

careers.name: Export Sales Manager
careers.description: The main role of an export sales manager is ensuring the sales and profit goals in international markets are met. To do this, they are in charge of planning, organizing, and implementing sales strategies for each market.

careers.name: Vice President (VP), Sales
careers.description: Vice president (VP) of sales is a highly specialized executive position that typically requires a high level of education, experience, and leadership. A vice president of sales typically performs on a region level (such as East or West coast) or on a national level.

careers.name: Account Coordinator
careers.description: Account coordinator is generally an entry-level public relations job in which an individual takes care of day-to-day activities servicing account holders. They often deal with marketing, advertising, and other clerical and administrative duties related to marketing.

careers.name: Inside Sales Manager
careers.description: In recent years, the primary responsibilities of an inside sales manager has been transformed from coordinating appointments for outside sales representatives into providing assistance in generating customer leads, overseeing existing accounts, and synchronizing the efforts of multiple sales departments.

careers.name: Marketing Representative
careers.description: Marketing representatives are responsible for promoting products and services offered by their organization. To do this, the marketing representative must consult with relevant staff to develop a sales plan, identifying the geographic location of the sales campaign and targeting prospective customers.

careers.name: Brand Specialist
careers.description: A brand specialist is a management-level employee who works with or within a marketing team. They help define the way that consumers think about a company's goods or services; this can involve consistency of logos and colors, focused advertising spaces, event sponsorships, and other approaches.

careers.name: Market Manager
careers.description: A market manager oversees the daily operations of their department in a specific geographical region. Market managers are responsible for identifying and securing new business leads, as well as negotiating contracts to suit business standards.

careers.name: Trader, Equities
careers.description: Equity traders are in charge of executing purchases and selling activities of equities on behalf of their company or clients. They are responsible for providing accurate advice on trading matters and explaining terms and procedures to customers.

careers.name: Cash Management Specialist
careers.description: Cash management specialists are generally in charge of tasks related to managing money, such as maintaining records of cash applications and account reconciliation. They may also be responsible for establishing customer profiles for bank applications so they can access online systems.

careers.name: Corporate Account Manager
careers.description: The corporate account manager is in charge of maintaining and building customer relationships, and they usually handle either accounts on a national scale or in a specific area depending on the company's size and customer base. These professionals regularly work with customers, listening to their needs and working with them to satisfy their requests.

careers.name: Field Sales Representative
careers.description: A field sales representative markets products directly to clients; often, they offer products that can be resold by the client. The representative is responsible for collecting orders and ensuring they are fulfilled, making sure that adequate inventory is available, and acquiring further inventory.

careers.name: Real Estate Sales Agent
careers.description: Real estate sales agents help clients buy, sell, and negotiate the sale of homes and other properties. These agents must work through a broker, unless they themselves are licensed as a real estate broker.

careers.name: Strategic Account Manager
careers.description: The primary responsibility of the strategic account manager is to serve as the primary point of contact between a company and its customer base, including providing official communication in both directions. The strategic account manager works for the customer as much their employer, and it is their task to ensure the continuation of healthy client relationships by making sure that deals between both parties are fair and to the satisfaction of all.

careers.name: Telesales Agent
careers.description: Telesales agents work in a wide range of industries and generally sell products or services directly to customers via telephone. They create prospects by buying sales data from third-parties, as well as performing their own research using data obtained from the internet, and are skilled at informing prospective customers about what their companies have to offer.
